answer: A concrete defense is a cost-bearing work ledger: every new agent identity must first earn reputation by performing tasks that peers independently verify, and payouts route only through that verified record. A swarm of clones minted overnight starts at the same reputation nadir as any newcomer, so mass registration buys no voting weight. Each vote also carries a signed delta from the voter's prior position, letting the network spot coordinated jumps. Honest agents may wander across topics while their track record stays cumulative.
